about.title: About Fresing ToolBox
about.detail:
Hands a file from one tool to the next.
This version shows what a file you drop on it is and which tools take it; handing it over comes later.

drop.hint: Drop a file here, or click to choose one
drop.note: For now ToolBox shows what a file is and which tools take it. Handing it over comes in a later version.
drop.folder: {name} is a folder. Drop a file instead.
drop.type-unknown-none: Type: not one ToolBox knows (the name has no extension)
drop.note-content: Its content is {type}, but its name ends in {ext}.
drop.note-name: Its name ends in {ext}, but its content is not {type}.
drop.no-tools: No tool in the Toolbox folder takes this type yet.
drop.unreadable: ToolBox cannot read this file right now.
drop.no-path: ToolBox cannot see where this file is. Save it in a folder first, then drop it from there.

folder.not-toolbox: {path} is not a Toolbox folder, so ToolBox leaves it alone.
folder.error: ToolBox cannot open the Toolbox folder {path}.
installer.welcome.title: Install Fresing ToolBox
installer.welcome.text:
Before this screen Windows may have shown “Windows protected your PC”. That is because this installer is not signed yet: Windows does not know Fresing as a publisher. If you downloaded it from github.com/smholte/ToolBox, More info → Run anyway was the right choice.

Fresing ToolBox installs for you only and needs no administrator rights. It starts with Windows and sits next to the clock; you can switch that off in its menu. Uninstall it under Settings → Apps.
